context: Two cafe friends watch a passing parade and chat
purpose: Teach: いっそう/気が付い/解ら/みえ/陽気/続々/絶えず/浮上

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 見て、続々と山車が通っていくね。今日は人がいっそう多い気がする。
lines.en: Look, the floats keep coming one after another. There seem to be even more people today.
lines.style: Warm observational tone, slight excitement in her voice

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 本当に。窓際に座ったら、急に景色がみえてきて気分が上がっちゃった。
lines.en: Really. Once we sat by the window, the view suddenly opened up and my mood lifted.
lines.style: Soft dreamy delivery, romantic and slightly breathless feeling

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: あの陽気な踊り子さん、絶えず笑顔で手を振ってるよ。すごい体力。
lines.en: That cheerful dancer keeps smiling and waving without stopping. What stamina.
lines.style: Impressed and admiring, casual friendly observation

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ふと気が付いたんだけど、去年より規模が大きくない?なんか感動しちゃう。
lines.en: I just suddenly noticed, isn't it bigger than last year? It's kind of moving me.
lines.style: Reflective wonder, voice trailing into emotional softness

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 確かに。なんで急に人気が浮上したんだろうね、理由がよく解らない。
lines.en: True. I wonder why its popularity suddenly surfaced, I really don't understand the reason.
lines.style: Curious and puzzled, tilting head in mild confusion

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: SNSじゃない?あ、見て、あの花飾りの馬車、すごくきれい…。
lines.en: Maybe social media? Oh, look, that flower-decorated carriage is so beautiful.
lines.style: Quick guess then immediately distracted, dreamy admiration

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん、ずっとここで見ていたい気分。コーヒー、もう一杯いれてこようか?
lines.en: Yeah, I feel like watching from here forever. Want me to brew another coffee?
lines.style: Cozy and inviting, gentle barista hospitality

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: お願い。こんな午後、ずっと続いてほしいな。
lines.en: Please. I wish an afternoon like this could last forever.
lines.style: Wistful and content, romantic sigh of pure happiness
